newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle light test - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Tuesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm in a light test, USDA said. Trade fairly slow. Demand and seller interest light to moderate. Offerings current.
